## How to flash

1. Download `minimalpad_with_studio-v{version}.uf2` from **Assets** below.
2. Connect the MinimalPad to your computer with a USB cable that carries data. A charge-only cable won't work.
3. Press its reset button twice, quickly. A drive called NICENANO appears.
4. Copy the `.uf2` file onto that drive. The pad restarts with the new firmware.

Then change your keys in MinimalPad Studio, on the web or on your Mac.
